THE ENERGETIC SYSTEM

Freedom within a frame.

Every filament is calculated from a toroidal harmonic field. Energy controls distortion; coherence controls wave alignment; symmetry controls sector repetition. Dragging sets an orientation within ±π.

Time is quantized to 1/60 second. Presets reset the clock and orientation. Copy state preserves every parameter and the exact frame in the URL. Replay is pixel-repeatable on the same GPU and viewport; different GPUs may round floating point differently.

Bounded lenses

Engineering: bounded uniforms and fixed work per frame.
Mathematics: harmonic ratios and analytic time.
Art direction: contrast and chromatic hierarchy.
Reverse inference: choose a visual goal, then a known fixture.
Socratic inquiry: change one parameter; compare; undo.

These are deterministic design modes, with no AI model or hidden random behavior.
